commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one square full-bleed 1536x1536 CARTOON game illustration. Depict real recognizable horticultural objects at sensible scale and physically credible botanical problems. The situation and material are the main subject; Sylvain can be small, partly seen, or only his illustrated hands in macro views. Main objects centered, readable at 300px. Single scene, no frames, labels, readable words, numbers, logos, panels, inset diagrams, fantasy machines, giant objects, ice cubes, rubber ducks, rescue buoys, magical clouds or human faces on plants. Return the generated image local file path. SETTING IS MANDATORY: a compact INDOOR GROW CUPBOARD, enclosed on three sides with opaque cream/silver reflective liner and dark upright frame, artificial white horticultural LED lighting, normal clip-on fan and a tidy extraction duct. Show cupboard door edges or poles so the small enclosed space is obvious. Any working shelf is inside the cupboard or immediately in front of its open door. NO greenhouse, glass roof, windows, daylight, sunlight, garden, outdoor vegetation, endless crop rows, large industrial room or scenery. Match the supplied cupboard illustration for enclosed layout, and the separate mascot for drawing style. At seedling stage the LED should be a small propagation fixture.
